mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, reducing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower risk-free rate effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence and corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing sector momentum that supports corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of monthly job gains (PAYEMS > 150,000) relative to historical averages signals expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts delayed monetary easing, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate severe real economy contraction that triggers recession risk pricing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as rate hikes delay earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
